scope: Small public source probes only; no operational files or histories changed; no SteamDB, authentication, or personal identifiers retained.

sources.supports: Current online players for specified AppID, excludes offline users.
New review endpoint, input_json, query filters, no key required; anonymous cache up to 10 minutes; shared lower rate limit and 429.
Official app-group members represent followers; documented membersManage count requires developer login.

bulk_store.mapping_validation: All 4 requested IDs returned once, success=1, id=appid=requested AppID; names match.
bulk_store.must_not_merge_with: GetAppReviews all-purchase counts or language-specific summaries
bulk_store.price_unit_sample: Portal2 KR raw1100000 / formatted KRW 11000, scale100 verified only against this country/sample
bulk_store.free_rule: is_free explicitly true; preserve whether field was present
bulk_store.coming_soon_rule: is_coming_soon true + no purchase option -> no announced purchase price; do not infer zero

reviews_api.success_validation: HTTP status and response schema; no success field
reviews_api.num_per_page_0_actual_behavior: Returned 20 reviews in released-app probes; not a summary-only request. num_per_page=1 separately verified to return exactly 1. Author/body discarded.
reviews_api.comparison_probe: Portal2 purchase_type=0 total392163 vs StoreBrowse filtered392259; not numerically identical; filter/cache/version scope unresolved, keep series separate.

followers.existing_seed_checks: Both conflict; original evidence preserved, no count selected.
followers.automated_handling: 429 triggers domain cooldown/backoff and no memberCount fallback; failures/conflicts null.

implementation_notes: Preserve observed_at and source URL/filter/context per observation; not API cache creation time.
Do not backfill past samples or replace failed readings with zero.
Bulk tests cover 4 apps, not a new full 7164-game sweep.
Prices and reviews may decrease or be revised; snapshot changes are not guaranteed new purchases/reviews.
Base CCU may be unavailable for unreleased apps; demo CCU valid 0 remains distinct.
